info.name: Retrieves the JSON Web Key Set (JWKS) used for token, payloads and webhook signature verification.

items.docs: **Unique resource name:** api_authentication.v1.cert.jwks This endpoint provides a set of JSON Web Keys (JWK) as defined in RFC 7517. **Usage:** - Used to verify the signature of access tokens and refresh tokens. - Used to validate the `x-signature` header in the API responses or webhook events. - Ensures secure cryptographic verification of API interactions.
